nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What is the unique characteristic of the small-scale fleet regarding gear types?
nodes.answer: The small-scale fleet uses multiple gear types, unlike other categories which are associated with a primary gear type.
nodes.paragraph: Each category is associated with a primary gear type, except for the small-scale fleet, which uses multiple gear types. A complete description of the fleets can be found in the sup- plementary material (Supplementary material Table S3). Catch data are assigned to each fleet from official land- ings from the Catalan and Valencian Governments for 2021 for the harbours inside our study area (Castell de la Plana, Pe scola, Benicarl , Vinar S, Burriana, Calafell, Cambrils, Delta Ebre, La R pita, Les Cases d'Alcanar, L'Ametlla de Mar, Tarragona, Torredembarra, and Vilanova i la Geltr ) (Generalitat Valenciana 2021; ICATMAR 2023). 2021 can be considered a standard year in terms of volumes and spe- cies composition following the COVID crisis. The ecologi- cal model has been validated against prior data from the area to ensure its coherence. The link between the food web model and the value chain module was done through the FG landings and the fleet structure provided in the Ecopath model (Table S4 and S5). The basic estimates of the final balanced model, as well as the diet matrix, are presented in the supplementary material (Tables S6 to S7).
